P01.rationale: No portrait or human figure of any size is present on the page; it is entirely text-based.

P05.rationale: There are no case study sections or client portraits anywhere on the page.

P07.rationale: No press logos, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus is present.

P10.rationale: No oversized decorative numerals, giant quote glyphs, or large typographic ornaments are used.

P11.rationale: Statistics are cited in body text (e.g., 30%, €700–800M) but no charts, before/after visuals, or data visualisations are rendered.

P12.rationale: The upper half has a reasonable two-column text block and a checklist panel, but the lower half of the page is largely empty, preventing a dense editorial feel.

P13.rationale: The background is plain white with no texture, atmosphere, or visual treatment whatsoever.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable and scores absent.

P16.rationale: No device mockup, product image, or physical artefact is shown anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The page contains no imagery at all, so there is no stock-photo problem, but the complete absence of visuals is itself a compositional weakness.

N08.rationale: The bottom third to half of the page is entirely blank, representing a large, purposeless dead-whitespace region.

N10.rationale: There are no photos on the page, so no text-over-busy-image or awkward inset gap issues exist.
